subject: post
title: (R)POST.------IND.DY.TD.
description: Diagram in WI-28. (R)POST — the reality of postulation — is crossed with INDIV-DY-TD (individual tendencies). Note the explicit appearance of AFI-1 (affinity insight, first degree) as a node, marking that this diagram is structurally about whether the white improvisor's real postulation can reach AFI(1)-grade insight. The main line bends at INFO-DY (information dynamics): POST → INFO-DY → INDIV-DY-TD. AFL (affinity alignment) branches from the INFO-DY → INDIV-DY-TD stretch. (P)ATTN (the point of idea completion of attraction) branches from the POST → INFO-DY stretch. AFI-1 branches from (P)ATTN, and AFL-DY (affinity dynamics) and PROJ-DY (projectional dynamics) both branch from AFI-1.
